comparison.objective: Open a clamp meter around one selected motor lead, take a stable reading, and return the meter; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Carry a sprung-jaw instrument, hold it while actuating its trigger, and thread the open jaw around one conductor.
comparison.success_condition: Requires enclosure of the red lead alone for three seconds, then closed-jaw tray placement and clearance.
comparison.reason: Selective conductor enclosure and measurement dwell do not test fastener countertorque or retained articulation settings.
